description: This file is a Polyfill implementation for PHP 8.1 features, specifically providing a compatibility layer for the 'array_is_list' function within the Symfony framework.

classes.name: Php81
classes.description: A final class providing a static method to check if an array is a list, simulating PHP 8.1's 'array_is_list' function.

methods.name: array_is_list
methods.description: Checks if the provided array has sequential numeric keys starting at zero, indicating it is a list.
